BiblicalUsage: n m; 1) covering, shelter, hiding place, secrecy; 1a) covering, cover; 1b) hiding place, shelter, secret place; 1c) secrecy; 1c1) secrecy (of tongue being slanderous); n f; 2) shelter, protection
